pr_body:
When a user sets a request timeout, reduce the timeout for each consumption of that value so that the end-to-end time is more accurate to that value.

Fix #109407
pr_comment: Hi @prwhelan, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Ooo clever I will copy this in future

Is the logic with `maxRemainingTime` necessary when `maxRemainingTime == remainingNanos`?
Is it to handle the case where `currentTime` goes backwards?

I saw one case where `currentTime` went backwards.  There's a monotonic clock in Transforms that we could move to commons to help prevent this, but for now I just set a max time in hopes that it doesn't happen that often :crossed_fingers:
